text: Owner notice to the Contractor: the temporary access road has been damaged and earthwork encroachment was observed near the Malaysia viaduct. Rectification is required within 48 hours. Refer NCR-2026-311 and Clause C-14.2.
text_zh: 业主致承包商通知函：马来西亚高架桥附近施工便道损坏并发现土方侵占，要求在 48 小时内整改。参见 NCR-2026-311 及合同 C-14.2 条款。

text: Site inspection found a worker near an unprotected edge at an elevated workface with no fall protection; immediate action required.
text_zh: 现场巡检发现：工人在高处作业面靠近无防护边缘，缺少坠落防护，须立即处理。

text: Quality observation: concrete surface honeycomb found at the drainage wall after formwork removal in Indonesia.
text_zh: 质量观察：印度尼西亚排水墙拆模后发现混凝土表面蜂窝状缺陷。

text: Subcontractor method statement submitted for the Saudi Arabia metro requires local compliance and permit review before approval.
text_zh: 沙特阿拉伯地铁项目分包商提交的施工方案在批准前需完成当地合规与许可审查。
